name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold explorer headquartered in Reno, Nevada, focused on the Lapon Canyon project in the Walker Lane shear zone near Yerington, Nevada. The company is in the exploration stage and also holds the Lazy Claims property and additional gold and silver royalty interests in Nevada and Idaho. Significant gold intercepts from 2025-2026 drilling at Lapon Canyon have been the company's primary exploration news.
